A new beginning for your little one.

Vijayadashami is traditionally considered an auspicious time to begin a child's learning journey. At Daisy Montessori, we would love to make that beginning gentle, meaningful and joyful.

Vidyarambha on Vijayadashami

20 October 2026

If you are considering starting preschool for your little one this October, admissions are now open.

At Daisy Montessori, children experience Montessori-inspired learning through:

• Practical Life
• Sensorial exploration
• Language & stories
• Early Mathematics
• Music & Movement
• Creative activities

With age-appropriate programmes, small-group learning and a nurturing environment for children 1.5–6 years.

Enroll by 14 October to begin your child's preschool journey on 20 October.

And if you would like to experience our environment before making your decision, join our:

A Day at Daisy Montessori
Little moments. Everyday learning.

A typical day in our classrooms is filled with different kinds of learning.

Children explore language with movable alphabets, build vocabulary through conversation and flashcards, develop concentration through Montessori materials, explore mathematical concepts with counters and learn alongside one another.

Some learning happens independently. Some happens together.

And often, the most meaningful learning happens in these small, everyday moments.
